title: Industrial Loft · 5 Min to BNA Airport · Parking
description:
Touch down and unwind in this stylish industrial loft just 5 minutes from BNA Airport. Soaring black ceilings, exposed ductwork, and polished concrete floors give the space a bold, modern edge, while the open layout keeps it bright and easy. Cook in the full kitchen, relax on the sofa, or sleep 4 across a comfy queen and pull-out. Free on-site parking makes early flights and late arrivals stress-free. The space
Enjoy a thoughtfully designed space that blends comfort and convenience. This unit features a cozy queen bed for restful nights and a sofa bed to accommodate additional guests. The open living area is perfect for relaxing after a day out, while the layout makes it easy for up to 4 guests to stay comfortably.

Whether you're visiting for a quick trip or a longer stay, you’ll find everything you need for a simple, stress-free experience.

Guest access
Guests will have full access to the entire unit, ensuring privacy and comfort throughout your stay. Enjoy access to all living spaces, including the bedroom, living area, kitchen, and bathroom.
You’ll also have access to on-site amenities and parking (if applicable), making your stay convenient from check-in to check-out.

Other things to note
Important: All stays of 21+ nights require an additional mandatory cleaning fee. This fee is non-negotiable and helps maintain the property during extended stays. By confirming your reservation, you agree to this requirement.
